recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes directly related misleading navigation in active source pages and no further FHIR core source work is indicated for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-25031 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked FHIR core to add a no-properties base type for logical models so CDA V3 Act id elements and II.extension would not conflict with inherited Element.id and Element.extension.
initial_application: No prior combined-branch commit was tagged with Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-25031. The substantive application appears in untagged commit cbdf7d1e55dc4bfa1dc30fc526edee0491e05782, which rebuilt the abstract type framework, added source/datatypes/base.xml, registered Base as an abstract infrastructure type, and documented Base as having no properties or constraints.
additional_context: Zulip discussion for GF#25031 and MnM minutes confirm the intended design: Base is a bare ancestor for Element/Resource and for logical models that do not want id/extension. Current source already has those semantics, but source/types.html linked the Base logical-model sentence back to types.html, and source/logical.html had the Element and Base anchor targets swapped.
reconciliation: Changed source/types.html to link Logical Models to logical.html and changed source/logical.html to link Element to types.html#Element and Base to types.html#Base. No structural Base definition changes were needed.
source_changes: source/types.html: corrected the Base section's Logical Models link to point to logical.html.
source/logical.html: corrected swapped Element/Base anchor targets in the logical-model base-type sentence.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same Zulip thread as a workflow-pattern logical-model baseDefinition follow-up; it concerns a separate artifact and was not decided here.
